claims: April 2026 Social Security payments for birth dates 1st–10th are scheduled for April 8.
April 2026 Social Security payments for birth dates 11th–20th are scheduled for April 15.
April 2026 Social Security payments for birth dates 21st–31st are scheduled for April 22.
Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients are paid on April 1, 2026.
Beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997 receive payments on April 3, 2026.
Beneficiaries who receive both SSI and Social Security receive payments on April 3, 2026.
Social Security benefits in 2026 include a 2.8% cost-of-living adjustment.
Average retirement benefits are estimated to increase to roughly $2,071 per month.
The maximum taxable earnings limit increases to $184,500.
